name: Web chat
note: Classic chat UI in the browser
summary: The agent sits behind a chat interface in a web page or web app: a message list, a composer and streamed replies. Developers usually build it with UI libraries such as AI SDK UI or assistant-ui, which handle streaming, message state and tool output rendering.
how: Expose the agent behind a streaming HTTP endpoint
Render a message list and composer in the browser
Stream tokens and tool results into the latest message
Persist threads so users can return to them
facts: AI SDK UI, assistant-ui, Chat SDK web adapter
Full control over UI, but users must visit your site
goodFor: Rich tool output and generative UI
watchOut: You own auth, abuse protection and hosting
Users must come to the page; no push by default
